title: Veeram Velancha Mannu
desc: Durai Pandi, a lumberjack, is very fond of his sister Meenamma and aims to make her the district collector. However, the MLA tricks him into cutting sandalwood trees and smuggling illegal goods.

title: Vetri Malai
desc: Jeeva and Madhavi live with their dad and stepmother. Jeeva marries Raja, while Madhavi is visually impaired and has trouble getting married. Madhavi's life takes a turn when she meets Raja's friend.

title: Unna Nenachen Pattu Padichen
desc: Two brothers, who live with their father and their grandmother, decide to kidnap their cousin. Things change when one of them dies in the ordeal and a meeting a called to resolve the situation.

title: Ammaiyappa
desc: The daughter of a landowner likes Ammaiyappan, a man loved by his mother and respected by his tribe, but he rejects her for reasons unknown.

title: Vaseegara
desc: Bhupathi's father sends him to live under the guidance of his best friend, Viswanath, and find a job. He gets close to the family and falls in love with Viswanath's daughter, who is already engaged.
